title: Use of antibodies against nk1, nk2 and/or nk3 receptors in cancer treatment
abstract: Use of antibodies against NK1, NK2 and/or NK3 receptors in cancer treatment. The subject matter of the present invention is the use of an antibody or a specific fragment thereof against NK1, NK2 and/or NK3 cell receptors for producing a drug for the therapeutic treatment of human cancer via direct administration to a mammal, including humans, by means of the production cell death or apoptosis of tumour cells, modification of the peritumoural microenvironment (which comprises stromal cells, stromal matrix and intra- and peritumoural vascularization) and/or the inflammatory and/or immune response surrounding the tumour. In particular, in the case of melanoma, carcinomas (principally, breast, lung, digestive tract, prostate, cervical, endometrial, ovarian and bladder carcinoma), leukaemias, lymphomas, neoplasias such as neuroblastoma, and sarcomas such as osteosarcoma.
